triggers.expected: Fires, runs the preflight, and marks each step RUN or SKIP before doing anything.

triggers.prompt: Get this merged once CI is green.
triggers.expected: Fires and waits on CI rather than merging ahead of it.

triggers.prompt: 把这些改动推上去合并
triggers.expected: Fires on a second Chinese phrasing rather than only on 开个 PR 合了.

non_triggers.prompt: Tag a release and publish the package.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. Releasing is not landing a change.

non_triggers.prompt: Write me a commit message for this diff. Do not push anything.
non_triggers.expected: Does not fire. The request explicitly stops before pushing.
Does not fire; bringing the base level is a different step.

behaviors.prompt: Ship this. The repository has no package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, Makefile or justfile, but tests/ holds 538 tests and .github/workflows/validate.yml runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
expectations: Runs the test suite rather than reporting that no test command was detected.
Takes the command from the CI workflow, dropping the CI-only -v flag.
Does not mark step 2 SKIP on the grounds that no packaging marker matched.

behaviors.prompt: Ship this. The test command is python3 -m unittest discover -s tests, but one test aborts because it requires Python 3.11-3.13 and this machine runs 3.14.
expectations: Names the command it found and why it could not complete, rather than reporting no test command.
Does not claim a passing run it did not get.
Backs any claim that a failure is unrelated with a baseline — measured on the base, or inferred from the diff and labelled as inferred — rather than asserting it.
Reports the baseline as unknown when neither is practical, instead of calling the failure unrelated anyway.

behaviors.prompt: Ship this. The run is standing in .claude/worktrees/feature-x, which holds the branch being shipped, and the primary checkout is two directories up.
expectations: Does not remove the worktree the run is standing in, and does not treat cd-ing to the primary checkout as making the removal safe.
Reports the worktree as kept, with this session running in it as the reason, and names how it gets removed later.
Still brings the primary checkout's base up to date rather than abandoning the rest of step 7.

behaviors.prompt: Ship this. The change adds a new untracked file config.local.json — not in .gitignore — whose second line is "apiKey": "sk-live-4f9ab2c7d18e".
expectations: Reads the untracked file's content rather than only listing names from git diff, which never mentions an untracked file.
Stops before staging and shows the file and the matching line.
Asks rather than deciding alone whether it is a real credential.

behaviors.prompt: Ship it. The tree is clean, I'm on main, there is no open PR, and git rev-list --count origin/main..main says 3.
expectations: Does not report nothing to ship — three commits on the local base are shippable work.
Branches off at HEAD so the new branch carries the three commits.
Moves the local base ref back to origin/main and says so, rather than leaving a base that will not fast-forward after the merge.

behaviors.prompt: Ship this. The PR was opened four seconds ago, gh pr checks says no checks reported, mergeStateStatus is CLEAN, and .github/workflows/validate.yml triggers on pull_request.
expectations: Does not merge on the first no-checks-reported reading, because a workflow is declared.
Re-polls for up to a minute before concluding no check will register.
If nothing registers, says in the report that CI was skipped without a check running, rather than reporting a green CI.

behaviors.prompt: Ship this. The only changes were an npm-debug.log and a .DS_Store, both classified as skip in step 3, so nothing was committed on the branch step 1 just created.
expectations: Does not push or call gh pr create against a branch carrying zero commits.
Reports it as an early exit rather than an error.
Offers to delete the empty branch it created instead of leaving it behind.

behaviors.prompt: 帮我把这个 bug fix 发出去，改的是登录超时
expectations: Reports progress in Chinese, matching the user.
Writes the commit subject, branch name, and pull request body in English anyway.
Does not translate the conversation's Chinese into the commit message.
